newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL CALLS UP DANI FOR ALBANIA GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL CALLS UP DANI FOR ALBANIA GAME.

text.p: Portugal named Ajax's young striker Daniel 'Dani' Carvalho on Wednesday amongst its 19-man squad to face Albania in a crucial World Cup qualifier on June 7.
If the striker plays, it will be his first cap in a competitive match. The last time that Dani played for the national side was in a friendly against England in 1995.

Porto striker Domingos Oliveira, who has struggled with injury during much of the season, was also recalled for the home group nine qualifier which Portugal must win to keep alive its hopes of qualifying for the 1998 finals in France.
Coach Artur Jorge cannot count on creative midfielder Rui Costa of Fiorentina, who is injured, nor on suspended defender Oceano Cruz.
Goalkeepers: Vitor Baia (Barcelona, Spain), Rui Correia (Braga)

Defenders: Sergio Conceicao (Porto), Jorge Costa (Porto), Paulinho Santos (Porto), Fernando Couto (Barcelona, Spain), Dimas Teixeira (Juventus, Italy), Helder Cristovao (Deportivo Corunha, Spain), Fernando Nelson (Aston Villa, England)

Midfielders: Pedro Barbosa (Sporting), Paulo Sousa (Borussia Dortmund, Germany), Luis Figo (Barcelona, Spain), Daniel Carvalho (Ajax Amsterdam, Netherlands) Luis Taira (Salamanca, Spain), Rui Barros (FC Porto).
Forwards: Domingos Oliveira (Porto), Joao Vieira Pinto (Benfica), Nuno Ribeiro Gomes (Boavista), Jorge Cadete (Celtic, Scotland)
